Callout.Name: Vehicle on the Pavement
Callout.Message: Vehicle driven onto the pavement, pedestrians having to step into the road.
Callout.Advisory: Driver still with the vehicle, no contact made.

Script.Line: He went up the pavement to get past the queue.
There were people on that pavement. A woman with a pram stepped into the road.
He turned off at the next junction. He is still local.

Lines.Approach: They have parked it across the pavement and they are still sat in it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
